name: DescribeFlowLogs

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the flow log.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
流日志所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the flow log.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
流日志名称。

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: flow_log_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the flow log
parameters.name: flow_log_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the flow log.

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
流日志描述信息。

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The resource type of the traffic to catch. Valid values:
          
NetworkInterface: network interface controller (NIC).
  
VSwitch: all network interface controllers (NICs) in a vSwitch.
  
VPC: all network interface controllers (NICs) in a virtual private cloud (VPC)
parameters.help_zh:
要捕获的流量的资源类型。取值：
          
NetworkInterface：弹性网卡。
  
VSwitch：交换机内的所有弹性网卡。
  
VPC：专有网络内的所有弹性网卡
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource whose traffic you want to capture
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The traffic type to collect. Valid values:
          
All: all traffic.
  
Allow: traffic allowed by access control.
  
Drop: traffic deny by access control
parameters.help_zh:
采集的流量类型。取值：
          
All：全部流量。
  
Allow：访问控制允许的流量。
  
Drop：访问控制拒绝的流量
parameters.name: traffic_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the project that manages the captured traffic
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the Logstore that stores the captured traffic
parameters.name: log_store_name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the flow log. Valid values:
Active: the flow log is active.

Activating: the flow log is being created.

Inactive: the flow log is inactive
parameters.help_zh:
流日志的状态。取值：
Active：流日志为启动状态。

Activating：流日志正在创建中。

Inactive：流日志为未启动状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in paging query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC whose flow logs you want to query
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the flow log belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

schema.description_en: The details of the flow logs

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in paging query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的流日志列表条目数
